"""Scratch verification (outside tests/): reproduce the issue scenario from
TASK.md — exclude() on an annotated FilteredRelation — against the workspace
Django checkout. Deleted after the run; not part of the repo's tests.
"""
import django
from django.conf import settings

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth'],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
)
django.setup()

from django.db import models, connection
from django.db.models import FilteredRelation, Q


class Author(models.Model):
    name = models.CharField(max_length=50)

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'scratch'


class Book(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=50)
    author = models.ForeignKey(Author, models.CASCADE, related_name='book')

    class Meta:
        app_label = 'scratch'


with connection.schema_editor() as se:
    se.create_model(Author)
    se.create_model(Book)

author1 = Author.objects.create(name='Alice')
author2 = Author.objects.create(name='Jane')
Book.objects.create(title='Poem by Alice', author=author1)
Book.objects.create(title='The book by Jane', author=author2)

# The exact scenario from the issue: exclude() on annotated FilteredRelation.
qs = Author.objects.annotate(
    book_alice=FilteredRelation('book', condition=Q(book__title__iexact='poem by alice')),
).exclude(book_alice__isnull=False)
result = list(qs)
assert result == [author2], 'exclude() result wrong: %r' % result
print('exclude() on annotated FilteredRelation ->', [a.name for a in result])

# Sanity: filter() variant still returns author1.
qs2 = Author.objects.annotate(
    book_alice=FilteredRelation('book', condition=Q(book__title__iexact='poem by alice')),
).filter(book_alice__isnull=False)
assert list(qs2) == [author1], 'filter() result wrong: %r' % list(qs2)
print('filter() on annotated FilteredRelation ->', [a.name for a in qs2])
print('OK')
